mapper.sql: COALESCE(M.DICT_ID, (SELECT SD.DICT_ID FROM TB_STD_DICT SD WHERE SD.DEFAULT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SD.DICT_ID LIMIT 1))

FROM TB_DATA_MODEL M JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A ON A.DM_ID = M.DM_ID AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(A.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select:
WITH USED AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT UNNEST(string_to_array(UPPER(TRIM(A.ATTR_NM)), '_')) AS TOK
AND = #{dictId} ) SELECT W.WORD_ID AS "id", W.WORD_NM AS "nm", W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "engAbrvNm", CASE WHEN W.WORD_CLSF_YN = 'Y' THEN '형식단어' ELSE '' END AS "extra", W.APRV_YN AS "aprvYn", to_char(to_timestamp(W.CRET_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "cretDt" FROM TB_WORD W WHERE W.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND W.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND (W.WORD_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_TERMS_WORDS TW WHERE TW.WORD_ID = W.WORD_ID) AND (W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM IS NULL OR W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM NOT IN (SELECT U.TOK FROM USED U)) ORDER BY W.WORD_NM LIMIT 5000

WITH USED AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(A.ATTR_NM) AS NM
AND = #{dictId} ) SELECT T.TERMS_ID AS "id", T.TERMS_NM AS "nm", T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "engAbrvNm", COALESCE(T.DOMAIN_NM, '') || CASE WHEN T.CODE_GRP IS NOT NULL THEN ' (코드 ' || T.CODE_GRP || ')' ELSE '' END AS "extra", T.APRV_YN AS "aprvYn", to_char(to_timestamp(T.CRET_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "cretDt" FROM TB_TERMS T WHERE T.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND T.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND (T.TERMS_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') AND (T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM IS NULL OR T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM NOT IN (SELECT U.NM FROM USED U)) ORDER BY T.TERMS_NM LIMIT 5000

SELECT D.DOMAIN_ID AS "id", D.DOMAIN_NM AS "nm", '' AS "engAbrvNm", D.DATA_TYPE || CASE WHEN D.DATA_LEN IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || D.DATA_LEN || CASE WHEN COALESCE(D.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN, 0) > 0 THEN ',' || D.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN ELSE '' END || ')' ELSE '' END AS "extra", D.APRV_YN AS "aprvYn", to_char(to_timestamp(D.CRET_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "cretDt" FROM TB_DOMAIN D WHERE D.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND D.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND D.DOMAIN_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_TERMS T WHERE T.DICT_ID = D.DICT_ID AND T.DOMAIN_NM = D.DOMAIN_NM) ORDER BY D.DOMAIN_NM LIMIT 5000
